# Scenario: cold restore — valid prod PEMs in .certs.json, empty live/ →
# materialize without ACME obtain.

pebble-start

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: certs.json cold restore fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

exec apinfra
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-cold.apinfra.test mode=prod'
stderr 'done duration='
exists $HOME/.certs.json
cp $HOME/.certs.json $WORK/certs.json.bak
cp $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-cold.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem $WORK/prod-fullchain.pem

rm -rf $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-cold.apinfra.test
! exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-cold.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem

env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH
exec apinfra
stderr 'restored prod cert from cache name=e2e-cold.apinfra.test'
! stderr 'obtaining domain=e2e-cold.apinfra.test mode=prod'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-cold.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-cold.apinfra.test/privkey.pem
grep 'prod' $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-cold.apinfra.test/.issued-mode
exec cmp $WORK/prod-fullchain.pem $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-cold.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

pebble-stop

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.provider=zerossl
certs.zerossl.AcmeKid=kid-1
certs.zerossl.AcmeHmac=zWNDZM6eQGHWpSRTPal5eIUYFTu7EajVIoguysqZ9wG44nMEtx3MUAsUDkMTQ12W
certs.zerossl.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-cold.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    container_name: e2e-web-container

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
echo '127.0.0.1'

-- .env --
